tools.name: search_passages
tools.description: Find verbatim passages where people at organizations described how they use AI, ranked by relevance with checked passages and the clearest statements first. tools.name: get_passage
tools.description: One passage by its id (the last part of its /passages/ URL), with its full citation.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Every question topic the archive files passages under, with a summary and passage count.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: One topic and its passages, clearest first.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: Every organization in the archive, with sector, passage counts and whether it sells AI tools.

tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: One organization: profile, size and results from its filings (each with its source), its people, and its passages, strongest evidence first.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: One person quoted in the archive: role, organization, why their word counts, and what they said.

tools.name: check_attribution
tools.description: Check a quotation about AI attributed to someone: looks in the archive's checked list of circulating lines, then for passages with the same wording. No match means the archive does not hold it, not that the quote is false.

tools.name: archive_stats
tools.description: How many passages, organizations and speakers the archive holds, and how many passages are checked.
